messages:
maria: Heads-up — I'm prototyping presigned download links for audit exports. Idea: two modes: `preview` (compact changelist NDJSON with masked PII) and `full` (complete compressed ledger). Default link TTL 24h. Thoughts?
aj: Important: quota enforcement has to be at generation *and* consumption. If we just check on generation, a leaked link bypasses per-request quota. We should enforce a per-tenant download allowance counter + rate limit.
sylvia: From compliance POV we need immutable access logs: who generated the link, who clicked it, IP, user-agent, and whether preview vs full was served. Also retention policy for those access logs (7y?) depends on customer. For PII masking, allow tenant opt-in for redaction profile.
ethan: Implementation note: generating an access event for every HEAD/CHECK may blow up. Proposal: emit a lightweight telemetry event on validation (sampled) and write a full audit record only on actual GET of `?mode=full`. For preview GETs, write a compact access entry.
maria: Good call. UX question: product-ux, would you want a console preview button that opens the compact changelist inline, or always redirect to presigned preview URL?
product-ux: Inline preview is preferred for quick checks — show top 20 changes and a link to full download. Show a banner: "Preview redacts PII" or allow toggling if tenant has opt-in. Also display "generated by" and time, plus a small cost estimate for full download.
aj: Cost-estimate needs telemetry hooks: token/line count estimate -> cost buckets. We'll attach a preflight job that samples the query and returns an estimated size. That preflight needs to be cheap and cached for 10m.
naveen: API shape suggestion: POST /v1/audit/exports with body {query, mode, ttl, notify} returns {export_id, presigned_url, preview_url, estimated_size}. Consumption endpoint is GET /v1/audit/exports/:id?mode=preview|full with standard auth. We'll attach HMAC on the link so we can always revalidate server-side.
ethan: Security: HMAC only is fine if links are validated server-side, but we should rotate link signing keys and add a revocation table for high-risk cases (legal holds).
sylvia: Legal hold: if a tenant places a hold, we must invalidate presigned links and prevent further generation for affected data ranges. Add a webhook so legal team's UI can request immediate revocation.
maria: Implementation spike: I'll open a small RFC describing storage of preview payloads (cached for 1h) vs large full dumps (S3) and the audit events generated. Need input on event shape.
aj: Event shape proposal: {actor, action: "export.generated|export.accessed|export.revoked", export_id, mode, resource_selector, bytes_estimate, tenant_id, trace_id}. Keep it flat and easy to NDJSON.
product-ux: For console, show an "activity" row next to an export: generated by, when, preview clicks, full downloads (count), size, status. Allow clicking the count to open the audit ledger entry in a sidepane.
ethan: Ops: presigned full downloads should be served from signed S3 with short TTL and a small proxy to attach audit headers on final download (X-Export-Id, X-Actor). We'll capture S3 access logs and reconcile with our audit events nightly for integrity checks.
naveen: Small gotcha: customers with private deployments may not allow S3. We'll provide a local object storage adapter and the same signed-link flow.
sylvia: Also ensure export content redaction is deterministic (same input => same redaction) so that downstream ediscovery workflows remain consistent. Add redaction profile id to event.
maria: One more thing — rollout mechanics: during canary we should produce an additional `export.debug` event that includes sampling of raw actor metadata for engineering triage, but those fields must be stripped in GA. Can we gate that with a rollout flag?
aj: Yes, rollout flag + retention TTL will do. Also add a config option to disable preview for regulated tenants.
deploy-bot: deploy started: services/audit-export v2.1.0 -> canary on eng-infra (sha: ab12fed).
ethan: After canary, let's run a 48h telemetry check for event counts and preview/full ratio. If preview hits >60% of downloads and costs explode, we'll throttle preview generation to 1/min per user.
product-ux: UX follow-ups: small modal for "generate export" with cost estimate, preview checkbox, and team note field (free text) that becomes part of the audit event.
sylvia: Approved from compliance subject to: access logs retention configurable, revocation API, and per-tenant redaction profiles.
maria: Thanks everyone — I'll turn this into an RFC + proto API and link it here when ready.
aj: Ping me on the API shape; I'll run a quick security review.
ethan: I'll instrument the telemetry counters: export.generated, export.preview_served, export.full_served, export.revoked, export.failures.
maria: Filing RFC now -> will post link
